full_panel.description: Original CTF resting TDE-HMM/TDE-DyNeMo network analyses and source independent-fit reproducibility panels. Preserve full branch-specific state/mode outputs, source summaries, maps and literal group comparisons required by those panels, along with within-branch fit selection. This is not a scalar-only fit task or an automatic six-branch/whole-paper requirement. Preserve all original 65 participants and physical sample support; eight HMM states versus seven continuous DyNeMo modes; each branch's inferred time courses, fitted covariance support, full spectra, spatial power/coherence outputs, participant dynamics and literal source group comparisons. Three independent optimization sets each retain all ten attempts and the original within-branch selected fit. Reproduce the selected outputs and stability across all three sets; six scalar selected-fit costs are partial support only. Keep both HMM NNMF components and complete thresholded/unthresholded quantities needed to verify plotted results. DyNeMo coefficient/intercept spectra and covariance-trace-reweighted continuous summaries remain distinct from HMM argmax dynamics. Original age assignments and apparent inverted plot labels must remain literal and explicit; harmonized age analysis is separate. No automatic Elekta/burst/static or Figures7-12 completion gate, event analysis, new held-person split or prospective surrogate control is imposed. Source-parity conflict: cached Figure5AIII describes Pearson correlation after concatenating renormalized mode time courses across subjects, whereas historical wrappers.py1966-1995 calculates each participant's reweighted-alpha correlation, zeroes its diagonal and plots the mean of those participant correlation matrices. Preserve the code-derived65x7x7 array; concatenated correlation and mean participant correlation are not assumed equivalent. The original group-coactivation aggregation/reference and publication equivalence remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same paper and original 65-participant source-reconstructed CTF network observations, demographics and common standalone contract; original group fitting can use its complete source cohort. Only authenticated historical author code is added in paper_data_author_code. Fitted matrices, trained checkpoints, deposited inference parameters/spectra, operator reference outputs and private verification state are not candidate inputs. Broader source branch inputs and prospective held-person/harmonized/event sensitivities remain separately scoped. Exact common-input/code/exposure manifests and equal cumulative access/resource budgets remain unqualified.
